appearance_facts.fact: Chart title: 'City Emissions Reduction by Program'.
Y-axis scale ranges from 0 to 70, with labeled ticks at intervals of 5 (0, 5, 10, ..., 70).
Bar 1 (leftmost) is green, labeled 'Building retrofits', with a value of 41.2% printed above it.
Bar 2 is light blue, labeled 'Transit electrification', with a value of 29.8% printed above it.
Bar 3 is purple, labeled 'Industrial efficiency', with a value of 18.5% printed above it.
Bar 4 is dark green, labeled 'Tree canopy', with a value of 7.2% printed above it.
Bar 5 (rightmost) is brown, labeled 'Methane capture', with a value of 3.3% printed above it.

public_definitions: The goal is to identify the emissions-reduction program with the largest contribution based on the dashboard chart and route it to the accelerated program review queue.
The comparison scope is the five programs shown in the bar chart: Building retrofits, Transit electrification, Industrial efficiency, Tree canopy, and Methane capture.
The rules are to use the reported reduction share percentage from the chart to determine the largest contribution.
